versions.description_html:
Discover how Microsoft OneDrive works, the difference between personal and work accounts, file syncing, sharing, version history, and its relation to SharePoint

Microsoft's OneDrive is one name hiding two completely different products. You might think the OneDrive on your home laptop is the same as the one your job handed you, but they are two separate accounts that only look alike.

In this episode of Simply Explained you will learn:
  • What OneDrive Actually Is
  • Two OneDrives, One Name
  • How Your Files Get Onto Your Computer
  • Sharing and Permissions
  • The Folder Backup You Didn't Ask For
  • Undo: Versions and the Recycle Bin
  • OneDrive vs SharePoint
  • Who's Really in Charge
  • Closing: The Short Version and One Question

Simply Explained by M365.FM breaks down Microsoft 365, Azure and modern IT topics in clear, jargon-free language. Hosted by Mirko Peters.
